property_location: Vaiyampalayam, Near Saravanampatti IT Park, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu
verified_facts: 2BHK ground floor house located near Saravanampatti IT Park in Vaiyampalayam, Coimbatore., North-facing site with a north-facing teak wood main entrance door., Land area measures 2.5 Cents with 890 sq.ft. built-up area on the ground floor., Includes borewell and an 8000-liter underground water sump., Interior features include a 16x16 living hall with full TV unit, pooja cabinet, false ceiling, semi-modular kitchen, 2 bedrooms with wardrobes and attached bathrooms, plus an external outer bathroom., Asking price is Rs. 56 Lakhs (negotiable), with 75% bank loan facility available.

content_plan.style: Relaxed, authentic local property presenter talking directly to camera in natural conversational spoken Tamil with standard English real-estate terms.
content_plan.hook_strategy: Lead directly with the highly sought-after Saravanampatti IT Park location and 2 BHK villa property type.

scenes.name: location
scenes.voice: கோவை சரவணம்பட்டி IT Park பக்கத்துல இருக்குற வையாம்பாளையத்துல ஒரு 2 BHK Independent Villa விற்பனைக்கு வந்திருக்கு.

scenes.name: land
scenes.voice: பாத்தீங்கனா, இது 2.5 Cents land area-ல அமைஞ்சிருக்கு.

scenes.name: builtUp
scenes.voice: 890 sq.ft. built-up area-ல 16x16 living hall, TV unit, pooja cabinet, false ceiling, semi-modular kitchen, அப்புறம் wardrobes இருக்கிற 2 bedrooms இருக்கு.

scenes.name: facing
scenes.voice: இதுல முக்கியமான விஷயம், இது North-facing site மற்றும் North-facing teak wood main entrance door கொண்டது.

scenes.name: approval
scenes.voice: இது DTCP approved house. தவிர borewell, 8000 Liters water sump, covered car parking மற்றும் terrace access வசதியும் இருக்கு.

scenes.name: price
scenes.voice: இதோட price 56 Lakhs, negotiable தான். 75% bank loan facility-யும் இருக்கு.

scenes.name: cta
scenes.voice: நேர்ல வந்து பார்க்க site visit பண்ணவோ, details தெரிஞ்சுக்கவோ உடனே call பண்ணுங்க!
